title: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
description: When you use our services, you’re trusting us with your information. We appreciate your trust in us to do that carefully and sensibly. This Notice outlines how we collect and use the personal data of our users.

sections.name: DataCollected
sections.heading: What Data We Collect
sections.content: We collect information to provide better services to all our users. We simply ask for an email and password. We will never ask for your home address or Social Security Number. Please keep in mind if any of these requests are made to ignore them and report the issue to support.

sections.name: WhyWeNeedInfo
sections.heading: Why We Need Your Info
sections.content: We collect user login information strictly to verify your identity and sign you into your account. We will not use your activity information to target ads or products.

sections.name: ThirdPartySharing
sections.heading: Sharing With Other Websites
sections.content: Your information is safely stored and never shared with third-party sites. Your data is intended to stay within our database and not be sold for profit to outside companies.

sections.name: AccountDeletion
sections.heading: Deleting Your Account
sections.content: As soon as you hit the delete button, we promise to have your account wiped from our database. All your personal information will not be able to be retrieved anymore. It is permanently wiped and we are unable to reverse any changes.
